node.title: Petal squarefree classification-ledger soundness
node.statement: If a ledger covers every squarefree realizable locator point in the residue-line kernels by disjoint charged or uncharged class records, every charged record cites an already paid family, every uncharged record has a polynomial bound with exponent independent of c, and the number of uncharged records is independent of c, then petal_squarefree_kernel_classification_payload holds.
node.attack_surface: formal coverage and charged/uncharged dispatch for Petal squarefree classification ledgers
node.falsifier: a complete valid classification ledger while the squarefree-kernel classification payload fails
